facts.fact: Neela has no memory of learning the fisherman's double hitch; Ammu always said a net-mender behind the sheds taught them both, but the knot has simply always been in Neela's fingers (hint of Nellimala childhood).
facts.why: needed because the beat has Neela tie the hitch without knowing who taught her, which must reconcile with F358.

facts.fact: Meenu, Madhavi, Pavi, Thulasi, Kuttu, Kamalakshi and Thilak are among the forty-one odiyans at the shelter; Vellan sits by the door carving a bird.
facts.why: needed to populate the vote scene with established names.

facts.fact: The Company is a half-joking name Kuttu coined for the forty and the plank; it has not been formally agreed. Forty-one odiyans, Vellan included, share the thin resin.
facts.why: needed because the beat calls the group 'the Company' and has Devan ask its leave.

facts.fact: From the shelter's ridge, after the cloud lifts, the sea and the Nellimala strand are visible; Neela recognises the bay's curve though she has never seen it from this side.
facts.why: needed for the beat of seeing the Thurai fleet off Nellimala.

facts.fact: Devan counts fifty-eight Thurai ships plus two fishing boats, about sixty; he says a controlled raid is six to twelve boats.
facts.why: needed to give his reading of the fleet concrete numbers.

facts.fact: Muthu is reading the crown's order from the gate chamber stair: the crown holds Kodiyur and the forts, the garrison stays inside the walls, and hill villages bear what comes. Kettamala's garrison will not go down.
facts.why: needed to render 'Muthu is holding a crown order' concretely; matches ch 2's letter.

facts.fact: Four members did not raise a hand in the resin vote and Neela directs the cup to them; the Company votes an even pinch for seven nights.
facts.why: needed to show the vote and Neela's care in action.
